parsed.reason: Description A says the handler fails to return after req.reject(requeue=False), so execution falls through and runs the task immediately ignoring its ETA, and also notes no result-backend failure is stored. Description B says the backend mark_as_failure call was removed, so no failure state is recorded for the invalid ETA. They overlap on the missing result-backend failure, but A's primary defect is the fall-through execution, which B does not mention; B frames the removed backend call as the defect, which A only mentions secondarily. Since the main root causes differ (missing return causing execution vs. removed backend write), they are not clearly the same defect.
